snippet.title: Codex Eternal Eclipse - Official Trailer | Indie Quest 2026
snippet.description:
Codex: Eternal Eclipse An RPG that tells a story about tragedy viewed through charming eyes. Codex is a story-rich, turn-based RPG where timing matters, and karma shapes fate. 

Embark on a quirky adventure with four unique main characters as they seek their truth, battling gods, colossal corporations, and bizarre foes along the way. Unravel the Eternal Eclipse mystery and uncover the world's ancient secrets! 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3039920/Codex_Eternal_Eclipse/

Developer: Mogu
